body:
This branch upgrades Neuron's local retrieval from one truncated vector per file to bounded, metadata-bearing chunks. Query mode now sends retrieved excerpts to Qwen, edited files replace stale vectors, and agent search observations include exact paths for follow-up reads. Image retrieval is still OCR/metadata-based; video retrieval uses subtitles/metadata and does not claim visual-frame understanding.

The packaged model is Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M via llama.cpp. Windows is built locally; GitHub-hosted macOS and Linux runners build the native packages and exercise the packaged CLI in headless mode. The smoke checks a page-8 PDF answer, path handoff, and reindexing after an edit. Runtime dependencies were reduced for packaging, and the frozen model download path, command classification, local-query privacy routing, and release checksums were hardened.

Validation: 244 passed, 2 skipped locally; retrieval regression passed on Windows, macOS, and Linux; packaged headless smoke passed on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The final Windows ZIP integrity check passed (4,098 entries, SHA256 `8a87c55d4f9cb051e73ea6711044d79d55fb3fb1402976a97784ac6ddaeaa19f`).
title: Ground local RAG answers in chunks and validate cross-platform headless builds
